headline: Nevish Line Roars On; Weathered Expanse Swings to Wardens
war_summary: The Nevish Line remains the furnace of this war. Sixty-nine actions in the past day, two dozen of them inside six hours, have left the sector at six Warden works against two Colonial, and the toll is still climbing: 320 Colonial and 385 Warden in the latest hour alone, with Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother among the places touched. Weathered Expanse has swung hard since the last edition, now reading six Warden works, one Colonial and two unclaimed after fifty actions about Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, six of them in the past two hours. Kuura Strand's long tangle at Faden Point and Talven has eased to two actions in six hours, the sector standing five Colonial and one unclaimed. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, but its guns have been silent since mid-morning. Linn Mercy counts eight Colonial works to two Warden and one unclaimed, fighting at Lathair continuing, its last six hours claiming some 2,349 Colonial and 3,209 Warden casualties. Godcrofts has gone quiet and wholly Colonial. Heavy attrition without a change of colours continues in the Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle.
